name: Shouta
source:
Shouta lives with his grandmother, the owner of the shop where Kaho is working part time. He lacks confidence and is generally disliked in school. 
However, Shouta has a perverted mind and thinks about sex all day, especially with Kaho who he idiolizes since the day she started working in the shop.

His parents are divorced.
